author: Marlon Chaviano
name: mobile-lynx
title: Mobile app with Lynx
description: Lynx, ByteDance's framework: truly native interfaces written with ReactLynx and CSS, rendered on two threads so the UI never blocks.
setupTasks: Lynx: install Lynx Explorer on the simulator or your phone and open the URL that `npm run dev` prints.
instructions:
## How to work here

- The UI is written with ReactLynx (`<view>`, `<text>`, `<image>`) and CSS; there's no DOM and no HTML tags.
- Event code runs on the main thread only if you mark it with `'main thread'`; everything else runs in the background.
- Develop with `npm run dev` and Lynx Explorer. Before finishing: `npm run build`.
